ruleDefinitions.name: Registry Explorer Policy Modification
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects registry modifications that disable internal tools or functions in explorer (malware like Agent Tesla uses this technique) Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: ((registry_path = RGX("SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Policies\\\\Explorer\\\\NoLogOff$") OR registry_path = RGX("SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Policies\\\\Explorer\\\\NoDesktop$") OR registry_path = RGX("SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Policies\\\\Explorer\\\\NoRun$") OR registry_path = RGX("SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Policies\\\\Explorer\\\\NoFind$") OR registry_path = RGX("SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Policies\\\\Explorer\\\\NoControlPanel$") OR registry_path = RGX("SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Policies\\\\Explorer\\\\NoFileMenu$") OR registry_path = RGX("SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Policies\\\\Explorer\\\\NoClose$") OR registry_path = RGX("SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Policies\\\\Explorer\\\\NoSetTaskbar$") OR registry_path = RGX("SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Policies\\\\Explorer\\\\NoPropertiesMyDocuments$") OR registry_path = RGX("SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Policies\\\\Explorer\\\\NoTrayContextMenu$")) AND Details = "DWORD\ \(0x00000001\)")
